title: Reiwa no Dara-san

thread.title: Dara-san of Reiwa • Reiwa no Dara-san - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: The dominant reaction is enthusiastic; many viewers consider the episode among the show's strongest and praise its blend of horror, comedy, and everyday slice-of-life.
Viewers especially enjoyed the exaggerated super-robot parody, including its music and presentation.
Kaoru's mischievous behavior and comedic use of supernatural abilities were repeatedly described as highly entertaining.
Several commenters found the episode's darker emotional material effective and expressed sympathy for the more compassionate character involved.
Some viewers enjoyed the supernatural encounter but felt its action was abbreviated and wished the confrontation had been shown in more detail.
A few comments criticized or found unpleasant the episode's deliberately bizarre tongue-related gag.
Some viewers felt Dara-san herself had too little present-day focus in the episode.

notes: The title and episode marker directly identify Reiwa no Dara-san episode 6. I retrieved the visible discussion and paraphrased reactions without quoting users or describing plot events.
